name: HangoutVR
summary:
Hangout VR is a colourful social game where you meet up with friends and play.

ROOMS
• My Dorm: dress up your avatar in the mirror and pick a hat.
• Plaza: the hub, with portals to every room, a fountain and a basketball hoop.
• Paintball: team battles against bots or friends on three maps: Park, Fort and Space.
• Dodgeball: 4v4 on a gym court. Hit them out, or catch a throw to get the thrower out.
• Disc Golf: 6 holes with trees and a pond.
• Space Station: low gravity, jump pads and floating asteroids.
